# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

<!-- Generated by [`auto-changelog-plus`](https://github.com/Lruihao/auto-changelog-plus). -->

## Unreleased

Align the CLI and SDK with the Go `devicebase-cli` contract: three platform
groups, one typed SDK method per endpoint, and the API's error layers surfaced.

### :boom: Breaking Changes

- **CLI**: the deprecated top-level aliases (`tap`, `swipe`, … `device-info`) are
  removed. Use the `mobile` group — `devicebase mobile -s <serialno> tap 100,200`.
- **CLI**: `-s, --serial` is renamed `-s, --serialno`.
- **SDK**: `getScreenshot()` / `downloadScreenshot()` are replaced by a single
  `getScreenshot()` that POSTs to `/v1/screen/{serialno}`. The old
  `/v1/screenshot/{serial}` route answered HTTP 200 with a `{"code":500}` body,
  which was handed back as if it were image data.

### :sparkles: Features

- **CLI**: `computer bash <command> [--timeout N]`, and `screenshot` in the
  browser and computer groups (the server dispatches `/v1/screen` by device type).
- **CLI**: `mobile input` and `browser input` read the text from stdin when no
  argument is given, keeping secrets out of shell history.
- **CLI**: `list-devices --limit` (default 10) is kept — it is the one filter the
  Go CLI lacks, and the `/v1/devices` route honours it. It is now validated
  instead of silently ignored when non-numeric.
- **SDK**: typed methods for every browser (21) and computer (15) endpoint, plus
  `listDevices`. `DeviceBaseHttpClient` is now composed from per-platform
  modules in `src/api/`, so the HTTP contract has a single definition.

### :bug: Bug Fixes

- **SDK**: surface the business error layer — an HTTP 200 carrying a non-2xx
  envelope `code` used to be reported as success (`&&` chains could not be
  trusted). Error messages now keep the server's own body.
- **SDK**: `computer wait` and `computer bash` widen the per-request deadline to
  cover the block; the shared 30s timeout aborted calls the server was still
  running.
- **CLI**: errors are thrown rather than exiting mid-write, so output is no
  longer truncated on a pipe. The screenshot format is sniffed and a
  contradictory file extension is reported on stderr.
- **CLI**: validate `--button`, `scroll` direction, `long-click --seconds`,
  `wait` and `bash --timeout`; `computer click` omits the button field so the
  server applies its own default.
- **CLI**: action commands print the server's envelope verbatim, matching
  `list-devices` and the Go CLI.
